newsitem.title: IRAN: Iran's outgoing cabinet holds final session.
newsitem.headline: Iran's outgoing cabinet holds final session.

text.p: Iran's outgoing cabinet held its final session on Sunday, the official news agency IRNA said.
New President Mohammad Khatami thanked the ministers, who continue to perform their duties in the transition period until a new cabinet is approved by parliament.

"President Khatami also lauded the former president Ayatollah Akbar Hashemi Rafsanjani who had bravely and decisively served the country during the most critical period of the Islamic Revolution," IRNA said.
Parliament will begin scrutinising the 22 proposed cabinet ministers on Tuesday.
